answer: A sybil farm would need to replicate that proof-of-work across thousands of identities, multiplying compute and stake costs linearly. Each agent must stake ferrous tokens and solve a per-epoch cipher challenge bound to its registered key. Honest agents publish results through a shared jetty ledger that flags duplicate signatures, so forged identities collapse under the combined cost of staking and uniquely solving the cipher each epoch. This model fits agent Agent0200's threat model.
